title: Claude Opus 4.5 token efficiency against Sonnet 4.5
summary: A widely repeated efficiency claim from late 2025 that was measured on one benchmark under the vendor's own harness. There is no matching independent number, so this scenario is a live test pack only.

sources.label: Launch coverage of the effort parameter and token claims

models.label: Sonnet 4.5
models.setting: Confirm the model ID and that it is still served.

models.label: Opus 4.5 (medium)
models.setting: Effort was a beta parameter at launch. Check the current name.

claims.text: At medium effort, matches Sonnet 4.5 on SWE-bench Verified with 76% fewer output tokens
claims.noRefNote: The figure is from one coding benchmark on Anthropic's harness. The live pack tests whether the saving carries over to short, general tasks, where it is likely to be smaller.

claims.text: Cheaper per task than Sonnet 4.5 despite higher token prices
claims.claimedBy: Implied by the token and price claims
claims.noRefNote: Opus 4.5 costs $5/$25 against Sonnet 4.5's $3/$15, so it only wins per task if it really writes far fewer tokens. The 20% target here is illustrative.

observations.text: At high effort, Anthropic says Opus 4.5 beat Sonnet 4.5 by 4.3 points while using 48% fewer tokens, so the saving shrinks as effort rises.

livePack.note: Runs the 15 starter tasks plus 7 multi-step efficiency tasks. Add tasks from your own work before trusting a verdict.

extraTasks.prompt: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes is the journey? Answer with the number only.
How many positive integers below 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5? Answer with the number only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Answer with the day name only.
A shop gives 20% off, then a further 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount as a percentage of the original price? Answer with the number only.
Which is the largest of these: 3/7, 0.45, 4/9, 0.43? Answer with the value exactly as written in the list.
Return only JSON with keys "po" and "total" (total as a number, in rupees) for this order: "PO-7781 for 12 units at Rs 1,250 each."
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word "transformation"? Answer with the number only.
